title: Refresher right after Borrowed Decree: second gravestone at the same time?
question: The old Refresher note claimed a third gravestone with Echo Shard. Echo can't go on the ult; does Refresher alone give two live gravestones, and can a natural recast add a third late?
hypothesis: H-GU-3: after Refresher, two gravestones are alive together. Late (Superior Cooldown, Enchanter's, Kevlar) the ult cooldown (~81-85s, additive vs multiplicative) stays longer than its duration (~60s), so a third live stone needs both a natural recast inside the duration, which this predicts does NOT happen.
controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Cast Decree, then Refresher, then Decree; count live gravestones
Record Decree duration and cooldown from the HUD

decision.rule: If refresher arm shows 2 live stones, SUPPORTS the note 'Use it right after your ult to cast it again'. If decree_cd < decree_duration, the note may add a third stone.
